chapter: To the US and the Caribbean with Carmen and Rolando
title: Six months in Puerto Rico
summary: The act played the Hotel Escambron, Cabaret Mocambo and Copacabana in Puerto Rico over six months before moving on.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Tell me where did you perform in Puerto Rico? How long were you there? How were you received? Let's stop in Puerto Rico briefly.

Okay. We arrived in Puerto Rico. We worked, debuted at the Hotel Escambrón. It was a tremendous success. After the Escambrón we went to the Cabaret Mocambo, which was also a big success. After the Cabaret Mocambo we went to the Cabaret Copacabana, also a great
success. After the Copacabana we went to Santo Domingo.
And how much time in total were you all in Puerto Rico?
Six months in total. Then we went to Santo Domingo . . . and we toured all over the country.
